# Orbyss Foundation Authentication Core

Provides `ValidatedAccountIdentity` and the stable authentication claim and error-code vocabulary.
The issuer and subject retain exact ordinal values; no URI normalization or account authorization is performed.
This contract assembly has no ASP.NET, ClaimsPrincipal, provider or feature activation dependency.
HTTP and principal admission belongs to `Orbyss.Foundation.Authentication`.
